# Nicolas Ghiggi

> Personal portfolio of Nicolas Ghiggi, a Computer Engineering student and Full Stack Developer based in Switzerland.

Nicolas Ghiggi is a Computer Engineering student and Full Stack Developer focused on building modern, reliable and user-focused digital experiences.

He works primarily with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Laravel, with an emphasis on clean architecture, performance, attention to detail and user experience.

## About

- Full Stack Developer
- Computer Engineering student
- Swiss Armed Forces Sergeant
- Based in Losone, Switzerland
- Available for new projects

Nicolas has experience across frontend and backend development and is interested in transforming ideas into well-designed software.

He values clean code, problem-solving, continuous learning, leadership, responsibility, discipline and teamwork.
